data.description:
## Description

**What**: Sprint Phase I self-use verification for epic c2cc-e3c4 SC-7. During the c2cc sprint itself, confirm the directory-size advisory hook is wired, executable via the session-start dispatcher, and that at least one session-start event has triggered it with one of: (a) a no-issues confirmation logged, or (b) at least one advisory ticket auto-filed with the canonical `directory-size-advisory` tag.

**Why**: Self-use Probe-1 means we dogfood the hook on this very sprint — not a follow-on sprint. SC-7 verification record evidence in the epic verification manifest so the completion-verifier can read it.

**Scope**:
- IN: Phase I verification at sprint wrap, after task 1706-b0cb has merged; must run from the live sprint session so the dispatcher has actually fired the hook; evidence captured in epic verification manifest
- OUT: Implementation of the hook itself (already owned by b026-bc46 / 3dcc-9f35 / bc70-c09b); changing the verification commands in SC-7

## Acceptance Criteria

- Hook executability verified: `test -x plugins/dso/hooks/dispatchers/session-start.sh` returns 0 AND the dispatcher sources `hook_directory_size_monitor` (grep confirms the source line)
- At least one session-start event during the c2cc sprint has invoked the directory-size monitor — confirmed via session log entry, hook stdout capture, or dispatcher trace
- Either (a) the hook emitted its no-issues confirmation line (captured verbatim in the verification manifest), OR (b) `.claude/scripts/dso ticket list --has-tag=directory-size-advisory --format=llm` returns ≥ 1 ticket
- Verification evidence (executability check output, session log excerpt, ticket-list output) appended to the epic's verification manifest under a `self-use-probe-1` section
- If neither (a) nor (b) is observed, task fails — does NOT pass by asserting the hook 'would have' fired
data.title: Self-use Probe-1: verify directory-size advisory hook fires during c2cc sprint
